# yescaptcha-client

## Classes

### YesCaptcha

Client for the YesCaptcha recognition API.

#### Example

```ts
const client = new YesCaptcha({ clientKey: "your_client_key" });
const balance = await client.getBalance();
```

#### Methods

##### createTask()

> **createTask**(`task`): `Promise`\<`string`\>

Submit a new recognition task.
Automatically embeds the application software identifier (`softID`).

###### Parameters

###### task

[`TaskParams`](#taskparams)

Captcha task parameters (e.g. `NoCaptchaTaskProxyless`, `TurnstileTaskProxyless`).

###### Returns

`Promise`\<`string`\>

The generated `taskId`.

###### Example

```ts
const taskId = await client.createTask({
  type: "TurnstileTaskProxyless",
  websiteURL: "https://example.com",
  websiteKey: "0x4AAAAAAA...",
});
```

##### getBalance()

> **getBalance**(): `Promise`\<[`YesCaptchaBalance`](#yescaptchabalance)\>

Check account balance.

###### Returns

`Promise`\<[`YesCaptchaBalance`](#yescaptchabalance)\>

###### Example

```ts
const { balance } = await client.getBalance();
console.log(`Balance: ${balance}`);
```

##### getTaskResult()

> **getTaskResult**\<`T`\>(`taskId`): `Promise`\<[`TaskResult`](#taskresult)\<`T`\>\>

Query the result of a submitted task.

###### Type Parameters

###### T

`T` = `Record`\<`string`, `unknown`\>

###### Parameters

###### taskId

`string`

Task identifier returned by `createTask`.

###### Returns

`Promise`\<[`TaskResult`](#taskresult)\<`T`\>\>

###### Example

```ts
const result = await client.getTaskResult(taskId);
if (result.status === "ready") {
  console.log("Solution:", result.solution);
}
```


##### waitForResult()

> **waitForResult**\<`T`\>(`taskId`, `options?`): `Promise`\<`T`\>

Poll `getTaskResult` until the solution is ready or the timeout is reached.

###### Type Parameters

###### T

`T` = `Record`\<`string`, `unknown`\>

###### Parameters

###### taskId

`string`

Task identifier.

###### options?

[`WaitForOptions`](#waitforoptions) = `{}`

Polling configuration (intervalMs, timeoutMs, AbortSignal).

###### Returns

`Promise`\<`T`\>

###### Example

```ts
const solution = await client.waitForResult(taskId, { timeoutMs: 60_000 });
```

##### stackTraceLimit

> `static` **stackTraceLimit**: `number`

The `Error.stackTraceLimit` property specifies the number of stack frames
collected by a stack trace (whether generated by `new Error().stack` or
`Error.captureStackTrace(obj)`).

The default value is `10` but may be set to any valid JavaScript number. Changes
will affect any stack trace captured _after_ the value has been changed.

If set to a non-number value, or set to a negative number, stack traces will
not capture any frames.

###### Inherited from

`Error.stackTraceLimit`

#### Methods

##### captureStackTrace()

> `static` **captureStackTrace**(`targetObject`, `constructorOpt?`): `void`

Creates a `.stack` property on `targetObject`, which when accessed returns
a string representing the location in the code at which
`Error.captureStackTrace()` was called.

```js
const myObject = {};
Error.captureStackTrace(myObject);
myObject.stack;  // Similar to `new Error().stack`
```

The first line of the trace will be prefixed with
`${myObject.name}: ${myObject.message}`.

The optional `constructorOpt` argument accepts a function. If given, all frames
above `constructorOpt`, including `constructorOpt`, will be omitted from the
generated stack trace.

The `constructorOpt` argument is useful for hiding implementation
details of error generation from the user. For instance:

```js
function a() {
  b();
}

function b() {
  c();
}

function c() {
  // Create an error without stack trace to avoid calculating the stack trace twice.
  const { stackTraceLimit } = Error;
  Error.stackTraceLimit = 0;
  const error = new Error();
  Error.stackTraceLimit = stackTraceLimit;

  // Capture the stack trace above function b
  Error.captureStackTrace(error, b); // Neither function c, nor b is included in the stack trace
  throw error;
}

a();
```

###### Parameters

###### targetObject

`object`

###### constructorOpt?

`Function`

###### Returns

`void`

###### Inherited from

`Error.captureStackTrace`

### WaitForOptions

Options for polling task completion.

#### Properties

##### intervalMs?

> `optional` **intervalMs?**: `number`

Polling interval in milliseconds. Defaults to 3000ms.

##### signal?

> `optional` **signal?**: `AbortSignal`

Optional AbortSignal to cancel polling.

##### timeoutMs?

> `optional` **timeoutMs?**: `number`

Maximum wait time in milliseconds before timing out. Defaults to 120000ms.
